title: Squeezed from both sides
lede: Big-box stores beat RadioShack on selection and price, the carriers opened their own stores, and the internet took the parts business. Its own partners were also its competitors.

blocks.body: RadioShack’s 10-Ks name competitors in general terms. The fates of Best Buy and Circuit City are well known but aren’t covered by the sources on this page, so we flag them.
